verdict.rationale: Restate officially ships SDKs for TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go and Rust. The Go and Rust SDKs have their own client libraries and changelogs, and the AI plugin covers patterns across TypeScript, Python, Java and Go, so teams can write workflows in their existing language. The old HN request for a Go SDK is superseded by the current Go SDK docs and is not a contradiction. missing for 10: explicit documentation or a matrix showing feature parity across SDKs (most cited develop docs and the testing companion library are TypeScript-specific), independent hands-on reports of non-TS SDKs.
